name: Gaming
description: Launchers, the Wine and Proton compatibility stack, performance overlays, and a Wayland-friendly Discord, ready to play.

items.name: steam
items.summary: Valve game store and client with built-in Proton compatibility.

items.name: lutris
items.summary: Open game manager for Windows, native, and emulated games.

items.name: heroic-games-launcher-bin
items.summary: Launcher for Epic Games, GOG, and Amazon Prime games.

items.name: wine
items.summary: Compatibility layer for running Windows applications on Linux.

items.name: winetricks
items.summary: Installs runtime libraries and tweaks into Wine prefixes.

items.name: protontricks
items.summary: Runs winetricks tasks inside Steam Proton game prefixes.

items.name: protonup-qt
items.summary: Installs GE-Proton and Wine-GE for Steam, Lutris, and Heroic.

items.name: gamemode
items.summary: Applies temporary performance optimizations while gaming.

items.name: gamescope
items.summary: Micro-compositor for upscaling, frame limiting, and isolating games.

items.name: mangohud
items.summary: Vulkan and OpenGL overlay for FPS, frametimes, and system metrics.

items.name: goverlay
items.summary: GUI to configure MangoHud and vkBasalt without editing config files.

items.name: vkbasalt
items.summary: Vulkan post-processing layer for sharpening, FXAA, SMAA, and deband.

items.name: vesktop-bin
items.summary: Discord client with Vencord and working Wayland screen share.
